scope: First S19 increment: gateway/geocode family integrated smoke, offline paired replay and cache-aware rollback rehearsal. Later families add modules under the same tooling paths.

server2_path_reasons.server2/deploy/smoke.sh: Release-binary integrated smoke entrypoint with local S3-compatible peer and recorded providers
server2_path_reasons.server2/tools/shadow/: Family-pluggable offline paired replay, scenario smoke and rollback rehearsal tooling plus manual renderer
server2_path_reasons.server2/tests/integration/: Python tool tests, Rust metrics regression test and frozen replay fixtures
server2_path_reasons.server2/tools/ci.py: Run the S19 tool tests and integrated smoke in the existing server2 CI job
server2_path_reasons.server2/src/gateway/metrics.rs: Additive aggregate gateway/geocoder counters; no request, coordinate, key or provider text
server2_path_reasons.server2/src/gateway/mod.rs: Count gateway outcomes and owned inflight work; no behavior change
server2_path_reasons.server2/src/gateway/backend.rs: Count legacy backend and legacy geocoder HTTP attempts; no behavior change
server2_path_reasons.server2/src/geocode/mod.rs: Count cache hits, joined waiters, owned flights, provider attempts and quota/capacity rejections; no behavior change
server2_path_reasons.server2/src/lib.rs: Append gateway counters to the existing loopback metrics response
